Use case: stylized-concept. NEW ORIGINAL KFB SLOP CHARACTER FAMILY, not an edit or continuation of any generated sheet. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 true transparent PNG sheet, EXACTLY SIX complete standalone characters, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Input image1 is ORIGINAL ink-family morphology/material reference; image2 is ORIGINAL occupational accessory craft reference. They are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: invent the new subjects below. Never copy their repetitive angry expressions or all-red eyeballs.

Every character is ONE WHOLE CONTINUOUS FOOTLESS dark charcoal/deep violet INK BLOB/SPLAT, thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, modeled lips and lids, irregular ivory teeth, a few detached droplets. UPRIGHT to camera, full dominant goo body visible below partial collar/accessories. No human torso, legs, feet, severed bust, lying body, cloth-shaped body or furry spikes. WHITE/IVORY SCLERA surrounding distinct RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL in EVERY visible eye. Soft handmade plasticine volumes, fingerprints, subtle violet sheen, warm upper-left studio light, exquisite rounded clay metal/wood/glass/fabric props. Offbeat grotesque cartoon charm, not cute Pixar mascot faces, angular/gritty clay or flat purple patches.

Six expressive peak moments. Different silhouette, mouth tension, lids, gaze and body attitude BEFORE outfit; never six hat-swaps or repeated V-brow grins. Exactly TWO female-read characters in specified cells, conveyed through styling and acting within the same ink species. All mature adults. Satire of petty certainty, institutional rituals and interrupted dignity, affectionate and absurd. Just ONE or TWO bold beautifully made props per actor, held at own body with immediate physical comedy; no complex conceptual contraptions. No floating emotion symbols. NO circular O-mouths or protruding tongues; vary crooked closed smile, flat sag, clenched grin, uneven open laugh and underbite instead.

Strict separated cells with generous empty transparent gutters and safe margins around entire silhouette, props and droplets, each fits comfortably within its own cell. Comparable visual scale without identical proportions. No overlap/touching, no shared objects, no reaching to neighbors. TRUE transparent alpha in all empty spaces and holes; NO background/gradient, scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow disc, painted checkerboard, text/numbers/labels/logos/captions/borders. Occupational/historical/retro-future context through props only.

FRESH SUBJECT FAMILY: EVERYDAY_SERVICES_12_2026-11-04; sheet services-consumption.
TOP LEFT slot1 male CUSTOMER COMPLAINT SPECIALIST: low broad sagging ink splat, small battered beige flat cap and tiny burgundy scarf collar. Furious crooked clenched UNDERBITE with three widely spaced ivory teeth, one eye squeezed and one huge red gaze forward. Both massive goo hands reverently hold a TINY crumpled blank ivory receipt at own belly, disproportionate solemnity, one simple paper prop; no text or floating anger symbols.
TOP MIDDLE slot2 FEMALE-READ CAFE SERVER: tall narrow curved pear ink blob, violet rolled goo quiff under short coral tied kerchief, tiny cream apron COLLAR ONLY. Warm exhausted SIDEWAYS open-tooth laugh with uneven teeth, one eye half closed and other focused down, no tongue. One hand delicately carries a comically TINY teal coffee cup, other hugs one huge plump ivory cream jug with brass-colored rim, two beautiful simple clay ceramic props. No tray/table or apron-shaped body.
TOP RIGHT slot3 male SUPERMARKET CASHIER: almost spherical compact ink splat with a single tall drooping top lobe, faded moss work collar and small rust-red visor. Alarmed wide white/red/black eyes looking down, mouth tightly compressed into a ZIGZAG with one bottom tooth, no grin. Cradles ONE old-fashioned chunky mustard mechanical cash register with a broad open drawer containing just THREE large blank copper coins, blank glass window and two big cream rounded buttons, no numbers/text. Whole blob dominant behind small handheld machine.
BOTTOM LEFT slot4 FEMALE-READ INSURANCE SALESPERSON: broad-bottom medium pear ink splat, sculpted violet swept goo crest, tiny teal collar and one fat copper earstud. Lazy perfectly certain CLOSED crooked smile with a gold fang, one eye narrowed in knowing wink and other looks forward. Holds a comically TINY CLOSED plum umbrella upright against own body like a sceptre, short rounded brass hooked handle; opposite arm hugs a chunky cream portfolio with blank cover. No umbrella overhead or background.
BOTTOM MIDDLE slot5 male BREAD VENDOR: very wide heavy UPRIGHT ink splat with rounded drooping side lobes, little soft cream baker cap and short indigo collar. Huge proud jagged sideways TOOTHY grin, eyes almost squeezed shut with white/red/black visible at corners, no tongue. Both goo arms squeeze ONE absurdly giant rounded rust-gold loaf of clay bread against own belly, four broad sculpted score grooves and soft finger dents. No basket clutter, signs or shop scene.
BOTTOM RIGHT slot6 male FASTIDIOUS BARBER: tall crooked bean-shaped ink splat with two short curled goo crown lobes, tiny faded rose work collar and little round brass spectacles. One white eye fully closed and other skeptically red-pupilled downward, pursed flat crooked lip with two small irregular teeth, NO round mouth or tongue. Delicately holds ONE tiny wooden comb in one hand and ONE huge ivory-bristled shaving brush with bulbous teal handle in the other, inspecting brush critically. No razor, mirror, chair, real hair/fur body or scene.
IMPORTANT SPACING REFINEMENT: Each actor PLUS ALL props and droplets must occupy no more than 85 percent of its own 512x512 cell in either dimension. Aim for at least 32 pixels fully empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides INSIDE EVERY cell. Keep characters equally readable and upright; nothing touches a cell seam or canvas edge.
